## Description

**What**: Extract the bug-type classifier dispatch into a shared helper script and integrate it at all other bug-closing sites in DSO skills (debug-everything, end-session, brainstorm convert-to-epic, sprint auto-resume, onboarding).
**Why**: S2 only wires the classifier into /dso:fix-bug. At least 5 other skills close bug tickets with Fixed: reasons, bypassing that hook entirely. SC3's "systematically at fix time" premise requires all closure paths to apply classification — not just fix-bug. Without this, backfill (S3) must be re-run perpetually to catch classifications missed by other skills.
**Scope**:
- IN: A shared helper script (e.g., plugins/dso/scripts/classify-bug-at-closure.sh) wrapping the classifier dispatch logic from S2; integration into /dso:debug-everything SKILL.md, /dso:end-session SKILL.md, /dso:brainstorm SKILL.md (convert-to-epic path), /dso:sprint SKILL.md (auto-resume fast-close), /dso:onboarding SKILL.md wherever Fixed: closures occur
- OUT: The classifier agent itself (owned by S2); the initial fix-bug integration (owned by S2)
- OUT: jira-* ticket handling via Jira bridge (separate concern per Jira consideration in S2)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a shared helper script (classify-bug-at-closure.sh or equivalent) encapsulates the full classifier dispatch logic from S2: dispatch bug-classifier-haiku, byte-exact output validation, failure-marker fallback (bug-type-uncategorized + bug-type-classifier-failed-<reason>), tag-write retry once, comment on second failure
  <- Satisfies: "SC3: systematically at fix time" for all closure paths
- When this story is complete, /dso:debug-everything SKILL.md invokes the shared helper at each Fixed: closure site
  <- Satisfies: SC3 coverage for debug-everything-closed bugs
- When this story is complete, /dso:end-session SKILL.md invokes the shared helper at each Fixed: closure site
  <- Satisfies: SC3 coverage for end-session-closed bugs
- When this story is complete, /dso:brainstorm SKILL.md (convert-to-epic path) invokes the shared helper at Fixed: closure
  <- Satisfies: SC3 coverage for brainstorm-closed bugs
- When this story is complete, /dso:sprint SKILL.md (auto-resume fast-close path) invokes the shared helper at Fixed: closure
  <- Satisfies: SC3 coverage for sprint-closed bugs
- When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding SKILL.md invokes the shared helper at Fixed: closure sites
  <- Satisfies: SC3 coverage for onboarding-closed bugs
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I can see bug-type tags applied regardless of which DSO skill closes the bug so that classification coverage is complete across all closure paths
